newsitem.title: DUBAI: SAUDI INDUSTRIAL FUND LOANS REACH $5.2 BILLION.
newsitem.headline: SAUDI INDUSTRIAL FUND LOANS REACH $5.2 BILLION.

text.p: The state Saudi Industrial Development Fund (SIDF) has granted 19.5 billion riyals ($5.2 billion) in loans to 1,447 projects in the past two decades, the official Saudi news agency SPA said.

The bank, which plays an important role in efforts to encourage the private sector, said the cumulative financing earmarked by the SIDF since it granted its first loan in 1977 stood at 28.2 billion riyals, SPA added.
It had received 12.3 billion in loan repayments, SPA said.
Saudi Arabia says it is committed to giving the private sector a bigger role in its economy as part of efforts to diversify from oil.
The leading sectors benefitting from SIDF loans last year were the engineering industry, chemicals, consumer products, cement industry and building materials industry. ($1=3.75)
